instructions: Choose Cloud, then select ISSM.
Open Environment & resources and find MATLAB LICENSE below the AWS connection.

chapters.screenText: Already configured? Prepare the local reference for reattachment.

chapters.title: Already configured? Prepare reattachment
instructions: If the masked input is hidden, open Advanced license configuration. Save the current ARN privately, clear Existing secret ARN, then choose Use existing secret.
First-ever entry skips this step.
chapters.note: This clears only the local reference; the AWS secret stays intact. Keep the saved ARN for recovery.
chapters.why: This recovery reattaches the existing license reference without overwriting its value.

chapters.screenText: Paste your own institutional address into the masked license field.

chapters.screenText: Wait for MATLAB license configured and the input to clear.

chapters.note: Keep that network connection and the Connector running until the native run ends.
